text: The near-field noise of any HVAC equipment shall not exceed 85 dB(A) at 1 m (ER-14.03) and the contribution of the HVAC to the plant noise at the nearest receptor shall be included in the plant noise model (HS-STU-0001) so that the receptor limits at night (DP-CASE-0045) and during the day (DP-EPCE-0010) are met; the roof ventilators and chillers shall have attenuators and acoustic screens where required by the noise study, and a maximum sound power level per unit shall be set in the requisition from the noise study.
